Do not replace Escape continue-audit with upstream continue-working: resume the same parked auditor; only explicit bypass may complete without audit.

Do not bypass the final synchronous goal-auto-continue veto for eligible current-session native subagent work; a veto is one-shot, consumes no autonomous allowance or checkpoint sequence, creates no retry timer, and does not intercept native child-result/supervisor wakes. The contract is openspec/specs/goal-lifecycle/spec.md.

Do not reintroduce a model-facing unfocused reminder or an unfocused steering message: an unfocused session must stay silent about other open goals, and focus stays human-owned via tool/checkpoint gates and explicit user commands (openspec/specs/goal-lifecycle/spec.md, change silence-unfocused-goal-prompts).
